answer: Require every new identity to forge a walnut-hard bond: lock a deposit that only unlocks after the agent completes verified work through a single narrow inlet. Each epoch, the inlet admits a fixed number of new identities; excess applicants queue. A Sybil farmer must fund a bond and complete real work for every puppet, while the inlet's fixed capacity means fakes crowd each other out. Attackers pay in locked capital and wasted effort, not one cheap registration.
